manual_comparison.note: No status column exists — stage derives from date presence (issueddate ⇒ permit_issued; approveddate only ⇒ approved; neither ⇒ permit_applied), and statusRaw stays honestly null. 32 of the 262 non-null contractorname values are placeholders and are dropped rather than emitted as businesses.
manual_comparison.data_quality_canary: Some historical rows carry an impossible issue date (observed: permitno P1405-006 with issueddate '2914-05-27', applieddate 2014) — a source-side typo. It is OUTSIDE this fixture window, and the D1 checkDateWindow invariant (2000-01-01..2100-01-01) flags such rows at runtime rather than ingesting them silently.

person_vs_business: ONLY contractorname is emitted, as business identity (contractor of record — e.g. 'WESTROCK CONSTRUCTION LLC', 'CORNERSTONE GENERAL CONTRS INC'). ownername and applicantname are routinely INDIVIDUALS (e.g. 'JENNIFER TAMBLIN', 'EDWARD MCMANAMNA') and are deliberately NOT emitted as organizations — person-gate, matching the Seattle precedent. Placeholder contractor values are filtered to null.
robots_terms: Socrata SODA open-data API, documented public endpoint. No auth, no robots restriction on /resource. Rate: bounded $limit/$offset windowed pulls with deterministic $order, SOURCE_USER_AGENT.
